title: Add HTML rendering helpers to Rust num-parser library
description: Brownfield Rust task: add a pub mod html with format_parse_html and format_list_html functions inline in src/lib.rs.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a pub mod html block inside src/lib.rs with two public functions. All 3 existing tests must still pass. pub fn format_parse_html(s: &str) -> String — tries to parse s.trim() as i32 — on Ok(n): returns {n} — on Err(e): returns {e} pub fn format_list_html(values: &[i32]) -> String — if values is empty: returns
  • empty
— otherwise: returns
    with one
  • {v}
    • per value Do not add any new files; add the module inline in src/lib.rs. All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: format_parse_html returns span with class='ok' and parsed value for valid integer strings
format_parse_html returns span with class='error' for invalid strings
format_list_html returns empty-state ul for empty slice
format_list_html wraps each value in a li element
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
